description:
Welcome to Lazy Brain Lab!

Understand the neuroscience of procrastination, dopamine habits, and effortless focus in plain English through minimalist 2D doodle stories.

Core topics: Behavioral psychology, dopamine resets, ADHD-friendly workflows, and habit science.
